process_area.title: FTA Preference, Duty Drawback & Bonded Operations

workflows.name: FTA Preference Strategy & Annual Duty Savings Analysis

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-analyze of "analyzes duty savings opportunity across FTAs" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "country for eligible SKUs" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "reports to Executive Committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-491 (ensure controlled execution — FTA Preference, Duty Drawback & Bonded Operations (PA-87.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost risk**: Missed preference over-pays duty; mitigated by annual savings analysis
System Touchpoints: - FTA savings model; sourcing decision support; savings report

steps.activity: Trade Compliance analyzes duty savings opportunity across FTAs (AFTA, RCEP, ATIGA, ACFTA, AKFTA, AJCEP, AANZFTA, PH–EFTA FTA)
Procurement incorporates FTA preference in sourcing decisions (e.g., shift volume to FTA-partner country for eligible SKUs)
Finance quantifies realized duty savings vs. baseline MFN duty; reports to Executive Committee

fields.Trigger: New vendor or FTA preference claim

workflows.name: Certificate of Origin (Form D/RCEP CO) Procurement & Vendor Onboarding

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates authenticity and accuracy" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks CO-back ratio" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-491 (ensure controlled execution — FTA Preference, Duty Drawback & Bonded Operations (PA-87.2).)
- operational: PO terms and CO-back tracking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Savings risk**: Missing CO forfeits preference; mitigated by PO terms and CO-back tracking
System Touchpoints: - CO repository; CO-back analytics; vendor CO scorecard

steps.activity: Procurement educates vendors on CO requirements (Form D, RCEP CO); incorporates CO provision into PO terms
Vendor obtains CO from origin-country authority; provides with shipment; Trade Compliance validates authenticity and accuracy
Trade Compliance archives CO; tracks CO-back ratio (claimable vs. actual); addresses vendor CO deficiencies

fields.Trigger: Re-export of previously imported goods or unused imported goods

workflows.name: Duty Drawback Scheme Application & Re-export Processing

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-import of "imports per Customs Modernization and Tariff Act" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-generate of "prepares drawback claim with import entry evidence, re-export proof, duty paid…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-file of "files drawback claim with BOC" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-491 (ensure controlled execution — FTA Preference, Duty Drawback & Bonded Operations (PA-87.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Recovery risk**: Missed drawback forfeits rightful refund; mitigated by identification and claim process
System Touchpoints: - Drawback claim tracker; import/export evidence; refund GL

steps.activity: Trade Compliance identifies duty drawback opportunity on re-exported or unused-destroyed imports per Customs Modernization and Tariff Act
Finance prepares drawback claim with import entry evidence, re-export proof, duty paid evidence
Trade Compliance files drawback claim with BOC; tracks adjudication; books refund

workflows.name: Customs Bonded Warehouse (CBW) Compliance & Inventory Reconciliation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-reconcile of "reconciles to BOC entries weekly" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System continuous audit of "Trade Compliance supports BOC CBW audit" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-491 (ensure controlled execution — FTA Preference, Duty Drawback & Bonded Operations (PA-87.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Inventory variance triggers BOC audit and penalty; mitigated by weekly reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - CBW inventory ledger; BOC entry reconciliation; duty-on-withdrawal

steps.activity: Trade Compliance maintains CBW license and operating conditions; ensures duty-suspended inventory segregation
DC Operations maintains CBW inventory ledger; reconciles to BOC entries weekly; reports movements (withdrawal for domestic sale triggers duty)
Trade Compliance supports BOC CBW audit; reconciles inventory to entries; remits duty on withdrawals

fields.Trigger: Import for eventual export or PEZA/BOI-registered customer

workflows.name: VAT Zero-Rating of Import for Resale/Export Documentation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-create of "Trade Compliance identifies imports qualifying for VAT zero-rating" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documentation for input VAT refund support" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-491 (ensure controlled execution — FTA Preference, Duty Drawback & Bonded Operations (PA-87.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Recovery risk**: Missed zero-rating over-pays VAT; mitigated by identification and documentation

steps.activity: Trade Compliance identifies imports qualifying for VAT zero-rating (re-export, PEZA/BOI direct sale) per CREATE More
Tax Accountant processes zero-rated import VAT; captures documentation for input VAT refund support
Trade Compliance archives evidence; supports BIR refund/TCC claim

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-test of "Treasury maintains customs bond/surety/guarantee facility" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "tracks bond utilization against facility limit" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconciles bond utilization" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-491 (ensure controlled execution — FTA Preference, Duty Drawback & Bonded Operations (PA-87.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Operational risk**: Bond facility exhaustion delays import clearance; mitigated by utilization monitoring
System Touchpoints: - Customs bond facility; bond utilization tracker

steps.activity: Treasury maintains customs bond/surety/guarantee facility (re-usable bond for CBW, transshipment, protest)
Trade Compliance applies bond to import entry as required; tracks bond utilization against facility limit
Treasury reconciles bond utilization; renews facility; addresses claims/calls on bond

fields.Trigger: TRQ opening or safeguard duty imposition

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitors DTI/BOC TRQ announcements and safeguard measures on relevant…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documents TRQ certificate or safeguard treatment" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-491 (ensure controlled execution — FTA Preference, Duty Drawback & Bonded Operations (PA-87.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost/compliance risk**: Wrong duty on TRQ/safeguard goods; mitigated by monitoring

steps.activity: Trade Compliance monitors DTI/BOC TRQ announcements and safeguard measures on relevant commodities
Procurement/Category Manager adjusts sourcing and pricing strategy in response to TRQ limits or safeguard duty
Trade Compliance applies correct duty at import entry; documents TRQ certificate or safeguard treatment

workflows.name: Freeport / Economic Zone Sourcing Strategy & Incentive Coordination

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-register of "registered vendors with duty/VAT incentives" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "Tax Manager validates incentive documentation" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "reports sourcing-strategy effectiveness to Executive Committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-491 (ensure controlled execution — FTA Preference, Duty Drawback & Bonded Operations (PA-87.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost risk**: Missed incentive opportunity; mitigated by annual strategy review
System Touchpoints: - Vendor incentive documentation; VAT zero-rating; savings analytics

steps.activity: Trade Compliance/Procurement identifies sourcing from Freeport/Ecozone-registered vendors with duty/VAT incentives
Tax Manager validates incentive documentation (PEZA/BOI Freeport certificate); ensures VAT zero-rating treatment
Finance quantifies savings; reports sourcing-strategy effectiveness to Executive Committee
